recipes.name: Strawberry banana smoothie
steps: Put the milk and yogurt in the blender first.
Add the banana and strawberries.
Blend for 45 to 60 seconds, until smooth.
Add a splash more milk if it is too thick. Pour into 2 glasses.

recipes.name: Green smoothie
ingredients: 1 cup (165 g) frozen pineapple or mango
1 cup (240 ml) milk or apple juice
1 tablespoon peanut butter or chia seeds (optional)
steps: Blend the spinach and milk first for 20 seconds, until no leaf bits are left.
Add the banana, pineapple and peanut butter.
Blend for 30 to 45 seconds, until smooth.
Pour and drink. The fruit hides the spinach taste.

recipes.name: Mango smoothie
ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 g) plain or vanilla yogurt
3/4 cup (180 ml) orange juice or milk
steps: Put the juice and yogurt in the blender.
Add the mango and banana.
Blend for 45 to 60 seconds, until thick and smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses.

recipes.name: Peanut butter banana smoothie
steps: Put the milk in the blender.
Add the bananas, peanut butter, oats, honey and cinnamon.
Blend for 45 to 60 seconds, until smooth and creamy.
Pour into 2 glasses.

recipes.name: Blueberry oat smoothie
steps: Put the oats and milk in the blender and let sit for 2 minutes so the oats soften.
Add the blueberries, banana, yogurt and honey.
Blend for 60 seconds, until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses.

recipes.name: Vanilla milkshake
ingredients: Whipped cream and a cherry for the top (optional)
steps: Let the ice cream soften on the counter for 5 minutes.
Put the milk, ice cream and vanilla in the blender.
Blend for 20 to 30 seconds, just until smooth. Too long makes it runny.
Pour into 2 glasses and top with whipped cream and a cherry.

recipes.name: Chocolate milkshake
ingredients: 3 cups (about 420 g) chocolate or vanilla ice cream
2 tablespoons malted milk powder (optional, for a malt)
steps: Let the ice cream soften on the counter for 5 minutes.
Put the milk, chocolate syrup, malt powder and ice cream in the blender.
Blend for 20 to 30 seconds, until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses.

recipes.name: Strawberry milkshake
steps: Blend the strawberries and milk for 15 seconds.
Add the ice cream and sugar.
Blend for 20 to 30 seconds, until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses.

recipes.name: Cookies and cream milkshake
ingredients: 6 chocolate sandwich cookies, plus 1 crushed for the top
steps: Let the ice cream soften on the counter for 5 minutes.
Blend the milk and ice cream for 15 seconds.
Add the 6 cookies and pulse 4 or 5 times, so there are still cookie bits.
Pour into 2 glasses and sprinkle the crushed cookie on top.

recipes.name: Peanut butter chocolate milkshake
steps: Let the ice cream soften on the counter for 5 minutes.
Put everything in the blender.
Blend for 20 to 30 seconds, until smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses. Drizzle more chocolate syrup on top if you like.

recipes.name: Strawberry pink lemonade
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) fresh lemon juice, about 6 lemons
steps: Squeeze the lemons. Ask an adult to help cut them.
Blend the berries, sugar and 1 cup of the water for 30 seconds, until smooth.
Pour through a strainer into a pitcher to catch the seeds.
Stir in the lemon juice and the rest of the water until the sugar dissolves.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Fresh limeade
ingredients: 3/4 cup (180 ml) fresh lime juice, about 7 limes
1/4 cup (60 ml) maraschino cherry juice (optional, for cherry limeade)
steps: Squeeze the limes. Ask an adult to help cut them.
Stir the sugar into 1 cup of the water until it dissolves.
Pour into a pitcher with the lime juice and the rest of the water.
Add cherry juice if you like.
Serve over ice with lime slices.

recipes.name: Mexican hot chocolate
ingredients: 4 oz (115 g) Mexican chocolate or semisweet chocolate, chopped
2 tablespoons sugar (skip if using Mexican chocolate)
steps: Heat the milk in a pot over medium heat until steaming, about 5 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Whisk in the chocolate, sugar and cinnamon.
Keep whisking for 2 to 3 minutes, until melted and frothy.
Stir in the vanilla and cayenne.
Pour into mugs carefully, it is hot.

recipes.name: White hot chocolate
steps: Heat the milk in a pot over medium low heat until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and whisk in the white chocolate until melted.
Stir in the vanilla and salt.
Pour into mugs and top with whipped cream or marshmallows.

recipes.name: Frozen hot chocolate
steps: Melt the chocolate in a microwave safe bowl in 20 second bursts, stirring each time.
Stir in the cocoa, sugar and 1/2 cup of the milk until smooth.
Pour into the blender with the rest of the milk and the ice.
Blend for 30 to 45 seconds, until slushy.
Pour into 2 tall glasses and top with whipped cream.

recipes.name: Southern sweet tea
ingredients: 1/8 teaspoon baking soda (keeps it from tasting bitter)
steps: Have an adult boil 4 cups of the water and pour it over the tea bags and baking soda in a heatproof pitcher.
Steep for 10 minutes, then lift out the tea bags.
Stir in the sugar until it dissolves.
Add the other 4 cups of cold water.
Chill for 1 hour. Serve over ice with lemon. Tea has caffeine, so it is best earlier in the day.

recipes.name: Half and half tea lemonade
ingredients: 3 cups (720 ml) cold brewed black tea
steps: Stir the sugar into the water until it dissolves.
Stir in the lemon juice to make lemonade.
Fill glasses with ice.
Pour in half tea and half lemonade. It has some caffeine from the tea.

recipes.name: Horchata
ingredients: 1 cup (200 g) long grain white rice
steps: Put the rice, cinnamon stick and 2 cups of the water in a blender and blend for 1 minute.
Pour into a bowl, add the other 2 cups of water and soak overnight in the fridge.
Blend again for 1 to 2 minutes, until the rice is very fine.
Strain through a cloth or fine strainer into a pitcher, squeezing out the liquid.
Stir in the milk, sugar and vanilla.
Serve over ice with a sprinkle of cinnamon.

recipes.name: Watermelon agua fresca
steps: Have an adult help cut the watermelon into chunks.
Blend the watermelon and water for 30 seconds, until smooth.
Strain into a pitcher if you want it smooth.
Stir in the lime juice and sugar.
Serve over ice with mint.

recipes.name: Agua de jamaica
steps: Have an adult bring 4 cups of the water to a boil in a pot.
Turn off the heat, add the hibiscus and cinnamon, and steep for 15 minutes.
Strain into a pitcher and stir in the sugar until it dissolves.
Add the other 4 cups of cold water and the lime juice.
Chill for 1 hour and serve over ice. It is caffeine free.

recipes.name: Mango lassi
ingredients: 1 cup (250 g) mango pulp or chopped ripe mango
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend for 30 to 45 seconds, until smooth and frothy.
Taste and add more sugar if the mango is not very sweet.
Pour into 2 glasses and sprinkle with a little cardamom.

recipes.name: Masala chai
ingredients: 4 black tea bags or 4 teaspoons loose tea
steps: Put the water and spices in a pot and have an adult bring it to a boil.
Simmer for 5 minutes so the spices flavor the water.
Add the tea and simmer for 2 minutes.
Add the milk and sugar and heat until it almost boils, about 3 minutes. Watch it, milk boils over fast.
Strain into cups. Chai has caffeine, so try a small cup.

recipes.name: Golden milk
steps: Whisk the milk and spices in a small pot.
Heat over medium low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, whisking, until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Take off the heat and stir in the honey.
Pour into mugs. Turmeric stains, so wipe spills quickly.

recipes.name: Hot spiced apple cider
ingredients: 8 cups (1.9 L) apple cider or apple juice
3 allspice berries or a pinch of ground allspice
steps: Put everything in a large pot.
Heat over medium heat until it starts to steam. Ask an adult to help.
Turn to low and simmer gently for 20 minutes. Do not let it boil.
Ladle into mugs through a strainer, leaving the spices behind.

recipes.name: Cooked eggnog
ingredients: 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg, plus more for the top
steps: Whisk the yolks and sugar in a bowl until pale.
Heat the milk, cream and nutmeg in a pot until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk the hot milk into the yolks, then pour it all back into the pot.
Cook on low, stirring all the time, for 5 to 7 minutes, until it reaches 160°F (71°C) and coats a spoon. This cooks the eggs so they are safe.
Strain into a pitcher and stir in the vanilla and salt.
Chill for 4 hours. Serve with a sprinkle of nutmeg.

recipes.name: Shirley Temple
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
Pour in the lemon lime soda and ginger ale.
Slowly pour in the grenadine. It sinks and makes a red bottom.
Top with cherries and an orange slice.

recipes.name: Italian cream soda
ingredients: 2 tablespoons flavored syrup, like strawberry, raspberry or vanilla
1 cup (240 ml) sparkling water or club soda
2 tablespoons half and half or heavy cream
steps: Fill a tall glass with ice.
Pour in the syrup.
Add the sparkling water and stir gently.
Pour the cream over the top and watch it swirl. Add whipped cream if you like.

recipes.name: Party fruit punch
ingredients: 4 cups (950 ml) cranberry or fruit punch juice
6 cups (1.4 L) chilled ginger ale or lemon lime soda
steps: Stir the juices together in a big punch bowl.
Right before serving, pour in the ginger ale so it stays fizzy.
Float the orange slices and berries on top.
Add ice or a frozen ring of juice to keep it cold.

recipes.name: Sherbet punch
ingredients: 1/2 gallon (1.9 L) rainbow or lime sherbet
8 cups (1.9 L) chilled lemon lime soda or ginger ale
steps: Pour the pineapple juice into a big punch bowl.
Add scoops of sherbet.
Slowly pour in the soda. It will foam up.
Serve right away in cups with a little sherbet in each.

recipes.name: Strawberry slushie
ingredients: 1 cup (240 ml) cold lemonade or apple juice
steps: Put the juice in the blender first.
Add the strawberries, ice and sugar.
Blend for 30 to 45 seconds, stopping to stir, until slushy.
Pour into 2 cups and eat with a spoon straw.

recipes.name: Orange cream whip
ingredients: 1/2 can (6 oz / 175 ml) frozen orange juice concentrate
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend for 30 to 45 seconds, until frothy and smooth.
Pour into 2 glasses right away. It tastes like a creamsicle.

recipes.name: Milk tea with tapioca pearls
ingredients: 1/2 cup (75 g) quick cook tapioca pearls
2 tablespoons hot water for the syrup
steps: Have an adult boil a pot of water and cook the pearls as the package says, usually 5 to 7 minutes.
Steep the tea bags in 1 cup boiling water for 5 minutes, then remove and let the tea cool.
Stir the brown sugar into 2 tablespoons hot water to make syrup.
Drain the pearls and stir them into the syrup.
Spoon pearls into 2 glasses, add ice, tea and milk.
Use wide straws. Pearls can be a choking risk for little kids, so sip slowly. Tea has caffeine.

recipes.name: Chocolate milk
steps: Stir the cocoa, sugar and hot water in a glass until smooth.
Pour in the cold milk and vanilla.
Stir well. Add ice if you like.

recipes.name: Fresh strawberry milk
steps: Stir the strawberries and sugar in a bowl.
Let sit for 10 minutes, until juicy.
Mash lightly with a fork.
Spoon into 2 glasses, add ice and pour in the milk.
Stir before drinking.

recipes.name: Korean style banana milk
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend for 30 seconds, until smooth.
Pour through a strainer for an extra smooth drink.
Serve cold.

recipes.name: Homemade ginger ale
ingredients: 1 cup (100 g) fresh ginger, thinly sliced
1/4 cup (60 ml) lemon or lime juice
steps: Have an adult slice the ginger.
Simmer the ginger, sugar and water in a small pot for 10 minutes. Ask an adult to help.
Let it cool for 30 minutes, then strain and stir in the lemon juice.
For each glass, mix 3 tablespoons syrup with 1 cup sparkling water over ice.
Keep the syrup in the fridge for 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Cucumber mint water
steps: Have an adult slice the cucumber and lemon.
Put the cucumber, mint and lemon in a pitcher.
Fill with water and ice.
Chill for 1 hour so the flavor goes into the water. Refill the water once or twice.

recipes.name: Strawberry citrus water
ingredients: A few basil or mint leaves (optional)
steps: Have an adult help slice the fruit.
Put the fruit and herbs in a big pitcher.
Pour in the cold water.
Chill for 1 hour, then serve over ice.

recipes.name: Root beer float
steps: Put the ice cream in a tall glass.
Pour the root beer down the side slowly. It foams a lot.
Top with whipped cream and a cherry.
Eat with a spoon and a straw.

recipes.name: Iced matcha latte
steps: Sift the matcha into a small bowl.
Add the warm water and whisk fast in a zigzag for 30 seconds, until frothy with no lumps.
Stir in the honey.
Fill a glass with ice and milk, then pour the matcha on top.
Matcha has caffeine, so it is a morning or early afternoon drink.

recipes.name: Thai iced tea
ingredients: 6 black tea bags or 1/4 cup Thai tea mix
1/2 cup (120 ml) evaporated milk or half and half
steps: Have an adult boil the water with the star anise and cinnamon.
Turn off the heat, add the tea and steep for 5 minutes, then strain.
Stir in the sugar and condensed milk until dissolved.
Chill for 1 hour.
Pour over glasses full of ice and top each with evaporated milk. Thai tea has caffeine.

recipes.name: Moroccan mint tea
ingredients: 1 tablespoon loose green tea or 3 green tea bags
steps: Have an adult boil the water.
Put the tea in a teapot and pour in 1 cup of the boiling water, swirl and pour it out. This rinses the tea.
Add the mint and sugar, then the rest of the boiling water.
Steep for 4 to 5 minutes.
Pour into small glasses. Green tea has some caffeine.

recipes.name: Warm mulled cranberry juice
steps: Put everything in a large pot.
Heat over medium until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Simmer on low for 15 minutes.
Ladle into mugs, leaving the spices in the pot.

recipes.name: Ayran yogurt drink
ingredients: 1 cup (240 g) plain whole milk yogurt
steps: Whisk the yogurt until smooth.
Whisk in the water and salt until frothy, or blend for 15 seconds.
Pour over ice and sprinkle with mint.
It is great with kebabs and spicy food.

recipes.name: Licuado de platano
steps: Put everything in the blender.
Blend for 30 to 45 seconds, until frothy.
Pour into 2 glasses.
Sprinkle a little more cinnamon on top.

recipes.name: Agua de tamarindo
ingredients: 3 tablespoons tamarind concentrate or 8 oz (225 g) tamarind pods
steps: If using pods, peel them, have an adult simmer them in 2 cups of the water for 10 minutes, then let cool for 15 minutes.
Mash the soft pulp, then strain out the seeds and strings.
Stir the tamarind with the rest of the water and the sugar until dissolved.
Add the lime juice, taste and add more sugar if too sour.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Pineapple coconut smoothie
steps: Put the coconut milk and juice in the blender.
Add the pineapple, banana and ice.
Blend for 45 to 60 seconds, until smooth and thick.
Pour into 2 glasses. This one is alcohol free.

recipes.name: Vietnamese iced coffee
steps: This drink is strong coffee, so it is for grown ups. Ask an adult before making it for yourself.
Put the condensed milk in the bottom of a glass.
Have an adult brew the coffee with the boiling water using a phin filter or pour over, about 5 minutes.
Stir the coffee into the condensed milk.
Pour over a glass full of ice.

recipes.name: Vanilla milk steamer
steps: Heat the milk in a small pot over medium low heat for 4 to 5 minutes, until steaming. Ask an adult to help.
Take it off the heat and stir in the honey and vanilla.
Whisk hard for 30 seconds to make it foamy.
Pour into mugs and sprinkle with cinnamon. It is caffeine free and nice before bed.

recipes.name: Sparkling cranberry punch
ingredients: 4 cups (950 ml) sparkling water or ginger ale
steps: Stir the juices together in a punch bowl.
Right before serving, pour in the sparkling water.
Float the cranberries and fruit slices on top.
Serve over ice.

recipes.name: Coconut lime cooler
steps: Stir the coconut water, pineapple juice, lime juice and honey in a pitcher until the honey dissolves.
Fill glasses with ice and mint.
Pour the cooler over the ice.
Serve cold.

recipes.name: Champurrado
ingredients: 2 oz (55 g) Mexican chocolate or semisweet chocolate, chopped
1/4 cup (55 g) brown sugar or piloncillo
steps: Whisk the masa harina into the water until smooth.
Heat the milk, chocolate, sugar and cinnamon in a pot over medium heat, stirring, until the chocolate melts. Ask an adult to help.
Slowly whisk in the masa mixture.
Simmer on low for 8 to 10 minutes, whisking often, until thick like a drinkable pudding.
Take out the cinnamon stick and pour into mugs carefully.
